title: Marlowe & Finch Alterations: Complimentary Basic Work by Service Class
content:
Marlowe & Finch Alterations offers complimentary basic work on garments bought at Marlowe & Finch in some service classes. This sheet sets out, class by class, whether basic work can be complimentary, which operations count, the purchase window, the qualifying price types and the per-ticket maximum.

| Service class | Basic operations complimentary for an eligible Marlowe & Finch purchase | Complimentary operations | Purchase window (calendar days after the purchase's completed date within which the garment must be dropped off) | Qualifying price types of the purchase | Maximum complimentary operations on one ticket | Sale-priced items receive complimentary basic work |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Express Hem & Cuff | yes | plain hem; cuffed hem; blind-stitched hem; plain sleeve shortening | 60 | regular | 2 | no |
| Standard Alterations | yes | plain hem; cuffed hem; taking in a waist; plain sleeve shortening | 60 | regular | 3 | no |
| Tailored Suiting | yes | cuffed suit trouser hem; shortening suit jacket sleeves | 90 | regular | 3 | no |
| Formal & Evening Wear | no | not applicable | not applicable | regular | not applicable | no |
| Bridal Alterations | no | not applicable | not applicable | regular | not applicable | no |
| Leather & Specialty | no | not applicable | not applicable | regular | not applicable | no |

## The same terms, read by class

- **Express Hem & Cuff and Standard Alterations** — complimentary basic work is available, with a 60-day purchase window and regular price as the qualifying price type; the per-ticket maximum is 2 in Express Hem & Cuff and 3 in Standard Alterations.
- **Tailored Suiting** — complimentary basic work is available on the two listed operations, with a 90-day purchase window and a per-ticket maximum of 3.
- **Formal & Evening Wear, Bridal Alterations and Leather & Specialty** — basic work is never complimentary in these classes; the window and maximum do not apply.

In no class does a sale-priced item receive complimentary basic work under these class terms.

## Illustration (hypothetical)

A pair of trousers bought at Marlowe & Finch is taken to Standard Alterations for a plain hem and tapering of the legs. Of the two, only the plain hem is on that class's complimentary list; tapering trouser legs is not listed and is not a complimentary operation in any class.
